pr_title: FEATURE: per-topic unsubscribe option in emails

validations.droid_claim:
[P0] Unsubscribe crashes when TopicUser row is missing

`TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` can return `nil` for users who haven't visited/engaged with the topic yet. The code then calls `tu.notification_level` which will raise `NoMethodError` and break the unsubscribe flow. Use `find_or_create_by` / `find_or_initialize_by` (with a sensible default notification_level) or otherwise handle the nil case before reading/updating `notification_level`.
validations.impact: Any user clicking unsubscribe from an email notification for a topic they haven't visited will hit a NoMethodError (500 error), completely breaking the unsubscribe flow.
validations.reasoning: Line 105 uses TopicUser.find_by which returns nil when no row exists. Line 107 immediately calls tu.notification_level without a nil check. TopicView.new (line 99) does not create a TopicUser row — confirmed by reading lib/topic_view.rb which has no reference to TopicUser. There is no before_action or other guard ensuring a TopicUser record exists before the unsubscribe action runs. A user can receive email notifications about a topic (e.g., via watching a category) without having a TopicUser row, making this scenario reachable.
validations.code_evidence:
Lines 105-113 of topics_controller.rb:
    tu = TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])

    if tu.notification_level > TopicUser.notification_levels[:regular]
      tu.notification_level = TopicUser.notification_levels[:regular]
    else
      tu.notification_level = TopicUser.notification_levels[:muted]
    end

    tu.save!
